description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Corgi is building a new generation of financial institutions and complex financial services. The company is seeking a Full Stack Engineer to build and scale a new product line, including customer-facing applications, internal tools, integrations, and infrastructure. The role involves translating operational needs into technical solutions, automating processes, owning projects end to end, and collaborating directly with product, operations, users, and leadership.
Full-stack product engineer building customer applications, internal tools, integrations, and workflow automation

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship full-stack applications that support the new product line
• Develop customer-facing products and internal tools
• Work across frontend, backend, databases, APIs, and infrastructure
• Translate business and operational problems into technical solutions
• Work directly with users and operators to understand their workflows and pain points
• Automate manual processes and build systems that allow the business to scale
• Design and implement integrations with third-party systems and APIs
• Own projects from initial concept and architecture through deployment and iteration
• Develop reliable, maintainable, and scalable software
• Debug, improve, and extend existing systems as the product evolves
• Work closely with product and operations to rapidly test and iterate on new ideas
• Travel to Corgi offices and operating locations as needed to work directly with the team and users

Requirements:
• No professional experience required if you can demonstrate your skills another way
• Strong experience building full-stack applications
• Fluency in modern frontend and backend development
• Strong understanding of databases, APIs, and software architecture
• Ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code
• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
• Comfortable working in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment
• Ability to take ownership of projects from beginning to end
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• US citizen/visa only
